name: Another Text Editor (ATE)
subtitle: Notepad, Vim and project tools
promotionalText: A simple notepad, a full text editor with vi/Vim-style keys, built-in offline syntax checks, and local project tools. Start simple; turn on more when needed.
description:
Another Text Editor (ATE) can be as simple as a notepad, as capable as a full text editor, or a workspace for your local projects. Start with a quick note and turn on advanced tools whenever you need them, on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

A SIMPLE NOTEPAD
Open ATE and start writing. Basic mode keeps everyday notes, lists and plain text straightforward. Choose readable document text from 10 to 54 points, light or dark appearance, and text or icon buttons. No account or setup is required.

A FULL TEXT EDITOR WITH VI/VIM-STYLE KEYS
Work across up to 12 document tabs with search and replace, Go to line, undo and redo, selection, copy, automatic indentation and syntax colors for 25 languages, including Java, C++, C#, Go, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Swift, Kotlin, PowerShell and Lua. Turn on optional Vim key bindings for modal editing with familiar vi-style commands. Vim mode works best with a hardware keyboard; ATE is not the complete Vim application.

BUILT-IN OFFLINE SYNTAX CHECKER
Check supported text and code without installing a compiler or sending your document to a server. Bundled checks cover JavaScript, TypeScript syntax, JSON, YAML, HTML, CSS, Python syntax, Java syntax, sh/Bash structure, SQLite SQL, basic C structure, XML, TOML and INI. Markdown includes selected lint warnings. Check while typing or run a check yourself, then tap an issue to jump to its location. Checks do not execute code, validate all program behavior or replace a compiler or IDE.

PREVIEW HTML AND MARKDOWN
See how an HTML page or Markdown file will look, full screen, then go back to editing. Preview is read-only and works offline: scripts never run and nothing is loaded from the internet.

A TOOL FOR LOCAL PROJECTS
Create and reopen projects, organize folders and subfolders, create new text files or add existing files to the folder you choose. Open files directly from the project tree. Transfer saved project files using ZIP import and export. Exact filenames are preserved, including names without an extension.

YOUR FILES, ON YOUR DEVICE
No account, advertising or advertising tracking. Documents and recovery stay on your device unless you choose a file provider or sharing destination. Save independent file copies: local recovery is not a backup or cross-device synchronization.

On iPhone and iPad, Save file uses the share sheet: choose Save to Files and complete the save. On Mac, use the native Save dialog. Full guides, support and privacy information are available from Help.

ATE is free, with no subscriptions or in-app purchases.

review.notes:
No account, login, subscription, purchase or review credentials are required. On first launch read Terms of Use, tick I have read and agree, then Accept and continue. Menu > Help reopens terms and links Privacy, Support and both guides.

Basic is the default. Write a note and Save file. iPhone/iPad: choose Save to Files in the system share sheet and complete the save. Mac: use the native Save dialog. Cancelling keeps the draft. Menu > Advanced enables syntax tools, Vim and Projects. Open project > New project creates a workspace; choose a folder then Add file > Create file or Choose files. Tap a file in the tree to open it. Close project keeps saved files. Delete folder previews contents and refuses unsaved affected tabs and project root.

Preview: create notes.md, type # Hello, then Menu > Preview; Back to editor returns. Preview is read-only, runs no scripts and loads nothing from the internet. For a bundled syntax demonstration, create demo.sql, enter SELECT FROM;, then Check syntax. Correct to SELECT 1; and check again. SQL is SQLite grammar; there is no database. Python checks syntax without executing imports or code. The App Store Mac edition uses offline Basic C and hides external compiler configuration. All parsers and Wasm assets are bundled for offline use.

ATE is a local general-purpose text editor with no hosted public content, messaging, browsing feed or program execution. External navigation is limited to user-requested help/legal/support pages. Developer does not collect document contents or app analytics. Website hosts may receive ordinary web requests. There are no regional feature differences.

Review contact phone is maintained privately in App Store Connect, not in this repository.
